_notes: The profile for the demo corpus. It exists so the project-annotation path is
exercised by a test rather than described: DemoSecured and Audited are known to
nothing that Métis ships, and this file is the only reason extraction understands
them. `exclude` is deliberately empty — the Feign client must be excluded by the
outbound_client role, not by a path glob, because a glob would prove nothing.
